# A short-groom, layered character target

**Retained original artist-discussion target, October 4.** One fictional adult character pairs a short swept groom and readable face with an open olive overshirt, ivory tee, sandstone trousers and brown boots. It chooses a whole-character composition different from the retained blue-knit/bob direction. Masculine styling is an authored intention; perceived gender and representative runtime support are untested.

![Original synthetic artist reference: short dark swept hair and an open olive overshirt over an ivory tee, sandstone trousers and brown boots](/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar/docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/masculine-character-target/concept-v1.png)

The body and larger portrait let us discuss an exposed forehead, coherent crown/temple flow, readable eyes/brows/jaw, a pointed collar and visibly separate inner tee. Full wrist-length sleeves, the outer hem, straight trouser fall and distinct boot uppers/soles describe the intended outfit. Root and the independent critic independently inspected the complete original and retain its coherent face, hair, collar and material palette. Fine beard shadow differs from the prompt’s clean-shaven intention; it is a named minor illustrative variation, not exact facial-finish acceptance. Pose and lighting differ between panels, so this is not exact geometric or colour correspondence.

One current [J.Crew twill example](https://www.jcrew.com/p/mens/categories/clothing/shirts/heritage-twill/garment-dyed-twill-overshirt/CI472) informed a pointed collar, visible weave and stitched placket. Root inspected the original folded salmon shirt on its official page; it provides no olive colour, worn open-layer shape, face or groom. Those, the original face and the complete outfit are deliberate artist choices. [Reference provenance](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/masculine-character-target/REFERENCES.md) preserves the limited observation.

This illustration supplies neither a new supported identity nor a curated starter recipe. Complete side/back/scalp/neck and garment interfaces remain undefined. Future 3D authorship must own head/groom attachment and materials, body/foundation exposure and coverage, all outer/inner layer surfaces and waist/seat/leg/boot interfaces, morph/rig/poses and moving appearance. It admits no construction or reuse of the rejected Rowan groom, old overshirt context, local hair/foundation or capture methods. The complete [AAA roadmap](../PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md), wider bodies/identities, expressions/gaze/gestures, outfits, performance, VTuber and Mii work remain open.

[Exact prompt](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/masculine-character-target/PROMPT.txt), [source admission](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/masculine-character-target/SOURCE-RESULT.md), [independent image verdict](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/masculine-character-target/RESULT.md), [root image reading](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/masculine-character-target/ROOT-IMAGE.md) and [exact receipt](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/masculine-character-target/RECEIPT.md). Built-in imagegen produced one unchanged1536×1024 original; its default copy and byte-identical project PNG remain preserved. No editing or regeneration followed.
